diagnostics.notes: Both claims are within-group baseline-to-follow-up changes in triglycerides during SGLT2 inhibitor treatment in T2D patients; extraction fields match their sources. Side A reports a significant decrease; side B explicitly reports no differences for triglycerides, triggering the not_replicated branch. Populations differ (not all patients on insulin in A; insulin-treated in B; 6 vs 4 months), but these are contextual, not comparability-blocking.

source_evidence.quote: triglycerides, aspartate aminotransferase, uric acid, E/E', deceleration time and systolic pressure in the pulmonary artery significantly decreased
A global cHDL increase was noted after treatment, while no differences were observed for total cholesterol, triglycerides or cLDL.

verdict.label: not_replicated
verdict.rationale: Both abstracts report within-group change in triglycerides after SGLT2 inhibitor therapy in T2D patients. Side A (PMID 37329705) reports triglycerides 'significantly decreased' in the SGLT2i group after six months, while side B (PMID 30503071) explicitly states 'no differences were observed for total cholesterol, triglycerides or cLDL' after 4 months. An explicit no-difference conclusion against a reported effect takes the not_replicated branch. Populations and follow-up durations differ somewhat (metformin-treated vs insulin-treated; 6 vs 4 months), but exposure, outcome and contrast type are sufficiently similar for comparison.
